package.name: katana_teleop
package.description: Keyboard teleop for the Katana 400 arm via ros2_control. Subscribes /joint_states, publishes JointTrajectory for jogging, uses FollowJointTrajectory actions for home/hold/gripper moves, and calls katana_hw/set_motors_enabled for motor power control. Requires arm_controller and gripper_controller to be active.
